name: browser-use-scripts
description: Browser automation command adapters for warm Chrome and browser target routing.

scripts.pack:assert: bun -e 'const expected = ["LICENSE.upstream", "dist/bin/browser-use-op-supervisor", "dist/browser-use.js", "package.json"]; const forbidden = ["TEST" + "-ONLY-PUBLIC-KEY", "TEST" + "-SIGNATURE", "browser-use.reviewed-action-" + "promotion-fixture", "GeneratePromotion" + "Fixture.swift", "BROWSER_USE_RUNBOOK_" + "AUTHENTICATED_STATE_PROOF", "BROWSER_USE_REVIEWED_ACTION_" + "APPROVAL_VERIFIER", "BROWSER_USE_AUTH_TOKEN_" + "RETRIEVAL", "BROWSER_USE_SECURITY_" + "SEAM"]; const packed = Bun.spawnSync([process.execPath, "pm", "pack", "--dry-run"], { stdout: "pipe", stderr: "pipe", env: process.env }); const stdout = new TextDecoder().decode(packed.stdout); const stderr = new TextDecoder().decode(packed.stderr); await Bun.write(Bun.stdout, stdout); await Bun.write(Bun.stderr, stderr); if (packed.exitCode !== 0) process.exit(packed.exitCode); const inventory = [...stdout.matchAll(/^packed\s+\S+\s+(.+)$/gm)].map((match) => match[1]).sort(); if (JSON.stringify(inventory) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) throw new Error(`Unexpected public package inventory: ${inventory.join(", ")}`); for (const path of inventory) { const bytes = await Bun.file(path).arrayBuffer(); const text = new TextDecoder().decode(bytes); for (const marker of forbidden) if (text.includes(marker)) throw new Error(`Public package leaks private or test authority marker ${marker} through ${path}`); } console.log("Public package inventory and private/test authority canaries passed.");'
